sloka: अर्धचन्द्रेण वदने शिरस्येकेन कर्णिना ।बाह्वोर्विव्याध नाराचैर्दशभिस्तं कपीश्वरम् ।। ५.४४.७।।।।
transliteration: ardhacandreṇa vadane śirasyekena karṇinā ।bāhvorvivyādha nārācairdaśabhistaṁ kapīśvaram ।। 5.44.7।।।।

translations.english: Jambumali released a crescentshaped arrow on the face, one earshaped (barbed) arrow on the head and ten iron arrows into the arms of the lord of monkeys.
